recommendation: Keep the commit. It preserves the already-applied Availability/extension design and fixes the only misleading current core example found for this seed. No further core source work is indicated unless PA or MnM later revisits the extension contexts; any cleanup of extension-pack-only wording should happen in the Extension Pack, not this core branch.
issue_request: FHIR-25381 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by PA. It requested a standard way to communicate Organization telephone/opening hours; the approved resolution created the Availability datatype, added a standard extension using Availability on ExtendedContactDetail, and migrated PractitionerRole, Location, and HealthcareService availability structures to the new datatype.
initial_application: The source history already applied the main model changes: a9d7aa77e8 migrated Organization.contact to ExtendedContactDetail through related Organization contact work, 447e89f4a4 created Availability and migrated the PA resource availability structures, and d763653d2d added the extended-contact-availability extension and an Organization example. Later source history moved the example to organization-hl7.xml, copied it into an invariant fixture, and moved the extension definition itself to the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Availability, ExtendedContactDetail, Organization, Location, PractitionerRole, and HealthcareService. The affected resources already use Availability, and the FHIR Extension Pack defines extended-contact-availability for ExtendedContactDetail, ContactDetail, and Address with valueAvailability. PA and MnM minutes, plus the Zulip committers thread, support the interpretation that Availability was approved for extension values. Related availability reconciliations already exist on the combined branch for FHIR-26641, FHIR-32498, FHIR-32499, FHIR-32500, and FHIR-50152.
reconciliation: Changed availableEndTime from 07:00:00 to 17:00:00 in source/organization/organization-hl7.xml and source/organization/invariant-tests/org-1.f1.fail.xml. No datatype, resource-structure, extension URL, or extension-pack definition change was needed.
